persistent — 持续的；顽固的

investigate — 调查；研究
Last week, Mei decided to investigate her skill gap.

transcript — 文字稿；抄本
Then she compared her notes with the video transcript.

endings — 结尾；词尾
She also missed the endings of words, such as '-ed' and '-s'.

pause — 暂停
She will pause after each sentence and repeat it.

confident — 自信的
Focus on the main idea first.' Mei feels more confident now.

gap — 差距；缺口
Last week, Mei decided to investigate her skill gap.

frustrated — 沮丧的
She feels frustrated.
